messages:
Lena (CSM): Kicking off HelixX Health onboarding. They purchased Redwood Private (VPC) with pilot target of 6 weeks. Key asks: SCIM provisioning, EU data residency, BYOK + HSM evaluation, and a low-latency inference profile for their triage UI. Need to map stakeholders, define success metrics, and surface any renewal risks.

Maya (Customer PM): HelixX contacts: Nora T. (CTO), Jamal P. (Infra), Dr. Ruiz (ML), and Elise (Security ops). They want twice-weekly syncs for first 2 weeks then weekly. Target pilot demo at week 4.

Ethan (Solutions): For inference SLA, proposing: p95 token latency < 150ms for 1-2k context, and end-to-end response < 300ms for triage flows. Also will recommend model variant with int8 quantization fallback.

Ravi (Onboard Eng): Checklist I9ll own: network peering + routing (day 3), staging cluster + smoke tests (day 7), BYOK KMS handshake (day 10). Will need Jamal's CIDR and VPN cert.

Sofia (Security): Compliance note 12: they require 12-month audit log retention and Azure AD PIM integration. If they want a custom HSM config that may add 2-3 business days. Flagging as potential renewal risk until HSM path is confirmed.

Kai (Enablement): I'll run three sessions: 1) API quickstart, 2) Ops runbook & cost-controls, 3) Dev best-practices for caching. Which timezone suits their devs? They prefer CET afternoons.

Lena (CSM): Action table (added to shared playbook):
- Owner: Ravi 012 network + staging (due day 3)
- Owner: Ethan 012 perf targets + quant plan (due day 6)
- Owner: Sofia 012 compliance + HSM plan (due day 9)
- Owner: Kai 012 enablement curriculum (due day 5)
- Owner: Maya 012 stakeholder invites + procurement notes (due day 2)
Link: https://docs.redwood.example/s/HelixX-onboard (please annotate deliverables).

Maya (Customer PM): I9ve added Nora and Jamal to the doc and sent calendar invites for the first sync (Tue 14:00 CET). Confirmed they prefer Tue/Thu cadence for week 1-2.

Ethan (Solutions): Quick perf test plan (will add to doc): baseline gen with 512 tokens, 8 concurrent streams, look at token p50/p95, memory footprint with KV caching.

Ravi (Onboard Eng): Network snippet for playbook:
```
# minimal egress
allow: tcp 443 -> api.redwood.eu
allow: tcp 22 -> bastion.redwood.internal (for support tunnel)
# prefer static peering IPs, provide VPN cert thumbprint
```

Sofia (Security): Also request HelixX share their internal pen-test window and Azure AD tenant ID for SCIM provisioning.

Lena (CSM): Procurement note: they asked for a DPA and SOC2 summary before ramping production. Maya, please coordinate with legal on expedited DPA draft.

Maya (Customer PM): On it. I'll chase Legal and set expectation: DPA draft in 48h. Also looping in Procurement to confirm billing cadence.

Kai (Enablement): I'll prepare CET-friendly sessions and record them for the customer's dev wiki. Will include a short checklist for cost control knobs (batching, cache TTLs, quantization).

Sofia (Security): KMS handshake: we support Azure Key Vault + GCP KMS + external HSM via PKCS#11. If they pick external HSM, schedule for day 12+ for integration testing.

Ravi (Onboard Eng): I'll provision staging with default 90-day logs and bump to 12 months pending procurement sign-off.

calendar-bot: Created event "HelixX onboarding - kick" at 1738070400 (Tue 14:00 CET) with guests: Lena, Maya, Kai, Nora T., Jamal P., Dr. Ruiz.

Lena (CSM): Summary: first sync Tue 14:00 CET, owners assigned above. Maya to confirm DPA timeline. Tag any blocker with #onboard-urgent.

Ethan (Solutions): Posting perf target doc to shared playbook by EOD.

Maya (Customer PM): Jamal posted CIDR and VPN cert thumbprint in the doc.

Sofia (Security): Legal uploaded SOC2 excerpt. HSM decision pending; reducing renewal risk if they accept Azure Vault.

Kai (Enablement): Slides + quickstart uploaded. Recording scheduled.

Lena (CSM): Great kickoff. Moving to twice-weekly syncs for first fortnight. Closing thread; will use playbook for tracking. :party-popper:
